newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Bank of Korea to supply $1 bln to banks in March.
newsitem.headline: Bank of Korea to supply $1 bln to banks in March.

text.p: The Bank of Korea will supply a total of $1 billion to seven local banks this month to help ease a dollar shortage, an official at the central bank said on Monday.
The official, who asked not to be identified, said the central bank would allocate dollar supply to individual banks after considering their applications.
"This will not end the banks' overall dollar shortage completely, although some might have spare dollars," he said.
The official said the local banks will have to repay the foreign currency within three weeks.
He said the move followed a dollar squeeze caused by the collapse of two steelmakers -- Hanbo Steel Co and Sammi Steel Co.
